title: Maximum Tastiness of Candy Basket
summary: Given an array of positive integers representing candy prices and a positive integer k, find the maximum tastiness of a basket containing k distinct candies.
statement: Given an array of positive integers representing candy prices and a positive integer k, find the maximum tastiness of a basket containing k distinct candies. The tastiness is defined as the minimum price difference between any two candies in the basket.
constraints: Choose exactly k distinct candy positions; equal prices are allowed.
Tastiness is the smallest absolute price difference among chosen candies.
hints: Sort prices so only adjacent chosen prices determine the minimum difference.
For a proposed gap, greedily choose the earliest next price at least that far away.
Binary-search the largest gap for which the greedy scan chooses at least k candies.
Feasibility is monotone, and earliest choices leave maximum room for later candies, proving both the greedy check and binary search.
editorial: Feasibility is monotone, and earliest choices leave maximum room for later candies, proving both the greedy check and binary search.

tests.explanation: Prices 5, 13, and 21 have minimum pairwise difference eight.
Choosing prices one and three produces the maximum difference two.
